```{r}
create_df <- function(raw_data_dir = "./rawdata") {
  folders <- list.dirs(raw_data_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  seurat_list <- list()
  for (folder in folders) {
    matrix_path <- file.path(folder, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
    if (!dir.exists(matrix_path)) next
    message("Reading: ", matrix_path)
    data <- Read10X(data.dir = matrix_path)
    seurat_list[[basename(folder)]] <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data, project = basename(folder))
  }
  seurat_list
}
seurat_objects <- create_df("../rawdata")
```

```{r}
for(obj_name in names(seurat_objects)) {
  seurat_obj <- seurat_objects[[obj_name]]
  seurat_obj <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt", assay = "RNA")
  seurat_obj <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^RP[SL]", col.name = "percent.ribo", assay = "RNA")
  
  assign(obj_name, seurat_obj, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  vln_plot <- QC_VlnPlot(seurat_obj)
  hist_plot <- QC_HistPlot(seurat_obj)
  scatter_plot <- QC_ScatterPlots(seurat_obj, low_nFeature = 500)
  
  assign(paste0("vln_", obj_name), vln_plot, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0("hist_", obj_name), hist_plot, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0("scatter_", obj_name), scatter_plot, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

# Filtering

```{r}
.mad_bounds <- function(x, nmads = 3) {
  m  <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  md <- mad(x, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  c(lower = m - nmads * md, upper = m + nmads * md)
}
```

```{r}
obj<-c("CO_CTRL", "CO_FUSED", "RO_CTRL", "RO_FUSED")

ProcessAndIntegrate_MADS <- function(object_names,
                                     mt_threshold = 5,    
                                     nmads = 3,            
                                     nfeatures = 2000,
                                     dims = 1:30,
                                     assay = "RNA",
                                     verbose = FALSE) {

  seurat_list <- mget(object_names, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  processed_list <- lapply(seurat_list, function(obj) {
    log_nCount   <- log10(obj$nCount_RNA + 1)
    log_nFeature <- log10(obj$nFeature_RNA + 1)

    b_counts   <- .mad_bounds(log_nCount,   nmads = nmads)
    b_features <- .mad_bounds(log_nFeature, nmads = nmads)

    keep <- (log_nCount   >= b_counts["lower"]   & log_nCount   <= b_counts["upper"]) &
            (log_nFeature >= b_features["lower"] & log_nFeature <= b_features["upper"]) &
            (obj$percent.mt < mt_threshold)

    obj <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[keep])
    
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay
    obj <- NormalizeData(obj, verbose = verbose)
    obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = nfeatures, verbose = verbose)
    obj
  })

  anchors    <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = processed_list, dims = dims)
  integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, dims = dims)
  integrated
}

df<-ProcessAndIntegrate_MADS(obj)
```

```{r}
stdev<-df[["pca"]]@stdev
var_explained<-(stdev^2/sum(stdev^2))*100

elbow_df <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained),
  percent_explained = var_explained
)
elbow_df$cum_explained <- cumsum(elbow_df$percent_explained)

ggplot(elbow_df, aes(x = PC, y = percent_explained)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = round(cum_explained, 1)), size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 12, linetype = "dashed", color = "#025e8d", size = 1) +
  labs(y = "Percentage of Explained Variance", x = "Principal Component") +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Export 

```{r}
DefaultAssay(df) <- "RNA"
df[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(df[["RNA"]])
library(SeuratObject)
library(Matrix)
out<-"../data/001_Integrated_export"
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_assay <- function(df, assay, outdir){
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  a <- df[[assay]]
  C <- SeuratObject::LayerData(a, layer = "counts")
  D <- SeuratObject::LayerData(a, layer = "data")

  if (!inherits(C, "dgCMatrix")) C <- Matrix(C, sparse = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(D, "dgCMatrix")) D <- Matrix(D, sparse = TRUE)

  Matrix::writeMM(C, file.path(outdir, "matrix_counts.mtx"))
  Matrix::writeMM(D, file.path(outdir, "matrix_data.mtx"))

  write.table(data.frame(feature = rownames(D)),
              file.path(outdir, "features.tsv"),
              sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
  write.table(data.frame(barcode = colnames(D)),
              file.path(outdir, "barcodes.tsv"),
              sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

  mf <- a@meta.data
  mf$feature <- rownames(mf)
  mf <- mf[, c("feature", setdiff(colnames(mf), "feature"))]
  write.table(mf, file.path(outdir, "var.csv"), sep = ",", quote = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
}

write_assay(df, "RNA",  file.path(out, "rna"))

write.table(df@meta.data, file.path(out, "obs.csv"),
            sep = ",", quote = TRUE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA)

if (length(Reductions(df))) {
  rdir <- file.path(out, "reductions"); dir.create(rdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (nm in Reductions(df)) {
    write.table(Embeddings(df, nm), file.path(rdir, paste0(nm, ".csv")),
                sep = ",", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)
  }
}

if (length(df@graphs)) {
  gdir <- file.path(out, "graphs"); dir.create(gdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (nm in names(df@graphs)) {
    G <- df@graphs[[nm]]
    if (!inherits(G, "dgCMatrix")) G <- Matrix(G, sparse = TRUE)
    Matrix::writeMM(G, file.path(gdir, paste0(nm, ".mtx")))
    write.table(data.frame(barcode = colnames(G)),
                file.path(gdir, paste0(nm, "_nodes.tsv")),
                sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("Exported to: ", normalizePath(out, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
```
